notes: What tools/film.py puts in each shot of our film. A shot that is not listed here (or has no frames/still) gets a placeholder drawn from spec/shots.json.
frames: a directory of developed PNGs named by FILM frame (fNNNN.png, e.g. out/dev from tools/camera.py develop); every frame of the shot must be there.
still: one PNG held for the whole shot (say so in note).
status: preview | final. subject: overrides the DESIGN.md section 4 table's 'our subject' column.
